name: Product Faker – Example product generator
author: Boldizar S. Santo

sections.description:
Product Faker – Example product generator is a development tool designed to quickly generate fake WooCommerce products for testing and development purposes. This plugin helps developers and store owners populate their WooCommerce stores with sample products, making it easier to test themes, layouts, and functionality without manually creating products one by one.

Key features:
* Quickly generate multiple fake products with realistic data
* Save time during development and testing phases
* Ideal for testing WooCommerce themes and plugins
* Perfect for creating demo stores or prototypes
* Easy to use interface for generating sample products

This plugin is intended for development and testing environments only and should not be used on production sites.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin generates fake WooCommerce products with realistic data for testing and development purposes. It helps you quickly populate your store with sample products without having to create them manually.

Is this plugin safe to use on a production site?

No, this plugin is designed for development and testing environments only. It should not be used on live production sites as it creates fake/dummy data.

How many products can I generate at once?

The plugin allows you to generate multiple products quickly. The exact number depends on your server resources and configuration.

What kind of data does the plugin generate?

The plugin generates realistic product data including product names, descriptions, prices, images, categories, and other WooCommerce product attributes.

Do I need WooCommerce installed to use this plugin?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated on your WordPress site for this plugin to work, as it specifically creates WooCommerce products.

Can I delete the fake products after testing?

Yes, the generated products are regular WooCommerce products and can be deleted individually or in bulk using WordPress and WooCommerce’s standard product management features.

Does this plugin affect my existing products?

No, this plugin only creates new fake products and does not modify or affect any existing products in your store.
